extensions.scope: Covers the client app (apps/client): the Mail surface, the chrome/shell, Settings, the Screener, and the App Switcher. The repo-facing marks (apps/client/public/{favicon.svg,icon-192.png,icon-512.png,icon-maskable-192.png,icon-maskable-512.png,apple-touch-icon.png,manifest.webmanifest} and docs/brand/{wicket-social-card.png,social-card.source.html}) still carry the postmark mark (src/brand/Mark.tsx) — the one drawn signature glyph that survived the rebuild, not a superseded asset. The sync backend has no UI.

themes.light: Bare :root is the light set (near-white ground), so nothing depends on a media query having matched.
themes.dark: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) :root:not(.light) and :root.dark carry the near-black ground. An explicit .light or .dark class always beats the OS.

darkOverrides.note: Accent lifts to a lighter violet (#8b80ff vs #4338ca) in dark rather than staying the same hex, so it still reads as *the* accent against a near-black ground without needing contrast tricks. Source: packages/design-tokens/src/colors.ts.

browserSurfaces.note: index.html's <meta name=theme-color> pair (light/dark) is on-system (surface-strong in each theme). apps/client/public/manifest.webmanifest still carries the retired Wicket frame value (#1A1611) — a stale repo-facing asset the ticket did not ask this pass to touch, not a second canon.
browserSurfaces.selection: accent ground (color-mix with accent-soft), ink text — src/index.css ::selection
browserSurfaces.scrollbar: thin, thumb var(--color-border) on transparent track

border.note: The one hairline that still exists — dividing rows in bordered-list contexts (Settings, Screener cards); never boxes in a Mail row.

accent.note: The one accent that means primary/current/focus, everywhere. Lifts to #8b80ff in dark.

accent-soft.note: Rank at rest — a selected thread row, the current nav tab, the App Switcher badge. Tint, never inversion.

tile-a.note: Ink pair #3730a3. Deterministic off the correspondent's address (mail/Avatar.tsx), not decorative choice.

tile-e.note: Ink pair #33415c. A closed set of five, not a hue wheel — a scanned list wants variety without noise.

heading.purpose: The open Thread's subject — the loudest text in the app, and the only place 21px appears. text-wrap: balance.

body.purpose: A thread row's subject/sender, message content, running UI text.

secondary.purpose: Meta lines, the reading pane's correspondent line, snippets.

label.purpose: Section labels, group-header names, the Command Palette's section captions. Sentence case, small, quiet — never uppercase, never letterspaced.

machine.purpose: Timestamps, group counts, byte sizes, key caps. Martian Mono, tabular figures.

fonts.delivery: Self-hosted from the app's own origin (Inter Variable, Martian Mono Variable) — a client whose promise is that you own your server has no business fetching fonts from a CDN on cold start.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system (--shadow-overlay). The Command Palette, the Shortcut Sheet, the composer, popovers, toasts — anything that genuinely floats above the ground.

shadows.name: header
shadows.purpose: --shadow-header: the global header's separation from the ground. An inset relief, not a drop shadow — the header never floats above anything, it sits at the top of the same ground, so it does not take --shadow-overlay.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Toast/palette entry, grid-column expansion (App Switcher), max-height disclosures.

motion.name: ease-pop
motion.purpose: Icon/badge pop moments — the App Switcher badge, nav icon transform.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Toast/palette entry, disclosure rotation, row hover/selection state.

motion.name: reduced-motion-floor
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce clamps every animation and transition in the app.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: The list/detail split collapses to one pane at a time (both stay mounted, one hidden); the header's row of view controls goes icon-only.

breakpoints.name: compact-header
breakpoints.note: The global header shrinks to 54px and the search entry's ⌘K hint text gives way so it doesn't crowd the field. There is no bottom tab bar at any width — the header keeps its shape.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.note: The split list widens to clear the row-fold breakpoint, so the single-line row layout renders instead of the folded two-line one.

breakpoints.name: row-fold
breakpoints.note: The row folds to a two-line grid. Container, not media: the same list is narrow inside the split and wide in List view at one viewport.

taper.note: mail/taper.ts: rank expressed as scale, not just position. Row/header heights taper from T1 (Pinned/Today, loudest) to T4 (Older/Undated, quietest); header heights are 26/24/22/20 plus the 26px group-header lead baked in as padding, since a virtualized item can't carry a margin the virtualizer never measured. compact shifts every tier by a fixed delta rather than flattening the taper to one size. Shared contract with VirtualizedThreadList's estimateSize — the ROW_HEIGHT/HEADER_HEIGHT values live once, in code, not duplicated into mail.css.

copy.source: CONTEXT.md is binding for UI copy.

boundaries: The message body is third-party HTML in a sandboxed iframe on its own ground. The design system stops at that boundary and may not restyle what a sender wrote.
Remote images are blocked until a sender is Approved, which is why correspondent marks are circular initial tiles drawn from the address and never fetched.
Density and layout mode are Device Preferences and never sync.
notCanonized: The App Switcher's reserved-App badge ('SOON') carries light tracking (0.03em) at 10px. DESIGN.md records this as a single deliberate, narrowly-scoped exception for a status chip, not as a general allowance to bring tracked caption type back into the system.

The shadcn primitives under src/components/ui/ ship Lucide hairline glyphs consistent with the current icon language; they are installed but adopted by no screen yet, so they are not asserted here as a confirmed pattern.

components.name: The App Switcher
components.description: Signature component: the left header cell. A hub-mark (soft rounded-square tile carrying the postmark and the current App's badge) expands via a grid-template-columns transition into a row of pill tabs, one per App, on open. The current tab takes accent-soft + accent ink and bold weight; a reserved App gets a small 'SOON' caption rather than being hidden.

components.name: The Thread Row
components.description: Signature component: a borderless, rounded row on the page ground. Sender (max 40%, ink-muted), subject (flex, ink-faint), right-aligned tabular-mono time, and a Done control revealed on hover/focus/selection rather than inserted. Hover takes color-hover; selection takes accent-soft (a tint, never an inversion). Unread bumps the sender to full ink + weight 600.

components.description: Signature component: a centered overlay (16px radius, --shadow-overlay, max 560px wide) behind a blurred scrim, opened by ⌘K. One text field, then sectioned rows each carrying a keycap. The active row takes accent-soft. Section captions are the Label tier — sentence case, never uppercase.

components.name: Postmark
components.description: The one drawn signature glyph that survived into The Instrument: a circular date-stamp mark broken at the lower left, with trailing bars. Appears as a solid mark on the pre-auth card and as a stroked cut inside the App Switcher's hub mark, on the same 24 grid as every Lucide icon.

narrative.overview:
The Instrument is a near-white (or near-black) ground with exactly one electric accent (#4338ca light / #8b80ff dark) doing every job that matters: primary actions, focus, selection, current-state. Nothing else in the palette is decorative — three ink strengths carry all text, three semantic signals (danger/warn/success) carry all state, and five tinted "tile" pairs give correspondent initials just enough variety to scan without noise. There is no second accent and no per-feature color.

Regions are separated by ground and gap, never by joinery. A list row, a menu item, a settings compartment — none of them sit inside a hairline box or a bordered plate. The one shadow in the system (--shadow-overlay) is reserved for things that genuinely float above the ground: the Command Palette, popovers, the composer, toasts. Everything else is flat, and rank between things at rest is expressed by a soft accent tint, not by inverting to solid ink and not by a colored badge bolted onto the side of a row.

This replaces an older system ("Wicket / The Sorting Office" — institutional stock, hairline joinery, struck ink, uppercase letterspaced "plates" for every label) which is fully retired from the Mail surface, the chrome, and the App Switcher. Two corners (pre-auth screens, Settings) still speak in its retired typographic voice and are recorded as an unfinished migration, not as house style.
keyCharacteristics: One electric accent, everywhere rank or action needs marking; nothing else is decorative.
Ground and gap, not joinery: no hairline box around a control, no plate behind a row.
Rank is a soft accent tint (--color-accent-soft) at rest, --color-hover under the pointer — nothing inverts to solid ink.
Corners come from one ladder: control → row → panel → pill, never an ad hoc radius.
Actions live in reserved whitespace, revealed on hover/focus rather than inserted, so arming a control never reflows its neighbors.
Type carries rank by size and weight. Labels are sentence case, small, and quiet — never uppercase, never letterspaced.
The document itself never scrolls: the shell owns the viewport, every routed pane scrolls on its own.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: {colors.accent} is the only color that means "this is the primary action or the current thing." A new state does not get a new color; it gets a tint of accent, one of the three semantic signals, or nothing.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Invert Rule
rules.body: Rank at rest is {colors.accent-soft} with accent ink, never {colors.ink} as a solid ground. The old system's "the selected row takes the ink and turns inside out" is retired everywhere the rebuild has touched.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Every label, heading, and caption in the rebuilt system is sentence case. text-transform: uppercase plus 0.10em+ tracking was the old system's signature "Label" voice and does not belong here.

rules.name: The Bounded Pane Rule
rules.body: .app-shell is 100dvh + overflow: hidden; every routed pane is its own height: 100%; min-height: 0 scroller. No exceptions — this is how the phone layout bugs stay fixed.

rules.name: The Ground-and-Gap Rule
rules.body: Regions separate by background-color change and whitespace, not by a hairline box or a card. A control that needs a boundary gets {rounded.md} and {colors.field}, not a 1px border around a {colors.surface} box.

rules.name: The One Float Rule
rules.body: If it's part of the frame at rest, it has no shadow. If it floats over the frame (Palette, popover, composer, toast), it takes --shadow-overlay — the same value, never a softer or harder variant.

dos: Do reach for {colors.accent}/{colors.accent-soft} for anything primary or "current." It is the only color that carries that meaning.
Do separate regions by background-color step and whitespace, not by a hairline box.
Do use the radius ladder (sm → md → row → panel → pill) — never an ad hoc value, never a Tailwind utility above md expecting anything but the same mapped corner.
Do keep every label, caption, and heading in sentence case.
Do set every machine-measured value (time, byte size, count, key cap) in Martian Mono with tabular figures.
Do give an action reserved whitespace and reveal it on hover/focus/selection rather than inserting it and reflowing neighbors.
Do keep .app-shell at 100dvh + overflow: hidden and give every new routed screen its own height: 100%; min-height: 0 scroller — this is what keeps the phone layout bugs fixed.
Do use CONTEXT.md's vocabulary verbatim in UI copy: Thread not conversation, Mail Account not mailbox, Screener not quarantine, Verdict as Unscreened/Approved/Blocked.
Do self-host faces from the app's own origin.
donts: Don't invert a selected/current element to solid ink. Rank is a soft tint, never an inversion, anywhere the rebuild has touched.
Don't set a label, heading, or caption in uppercase with letterspacing — that is the old system's signature voice and does not belong in The Instrument.
Don't put a border around a Mail-surface row or panel to separate it from its neighbor; change its background instead.
Don't give a control an ink color at rest. Ghost is the default voice: transparent → hover fill → soft-tint-when-current.
Don't animate a list's arrival, stagger rows, or transition height.
Don't fetch a correspondent's image or a font from a CDN.
Don't restyle a message body — it is third-party HTML in a sandboxed iframe and the design system stops at that boundary.
